text:
Jin K: quick sync - sketching an admission-guard + evict-broker to stop the cliff OOMs we saw. idea: gate allocations when predicted hotset growth > watermark.
Becca M: gate semantics? immediate reject or short delay?
Jin K: tri-state: ALLOW / DELAY (retry-after ms) / REJECT. DELAY triggers broker reclaim round across tenants.
Theo R: broker does ordered reclaim: local-unpin -> compress -> async checkpoint -> (opt-in) cross-tenant demote -> fallback-cpu.
Anita V: metrics and safety: per-tenant reclaim caps, sandbox handlers, and per-tenant tokens. no cross-tenant by default.
Becca M: tags on buffers: pinned, compressible:low/med/high, recompute_ms, checkpointable. allocator API accepts tags.
Jin K: rollout: behind feature flag, fast-path bypass when free_mem > high_watermark, microbench for p99 overhead.
Theo R: tests: synthetic churn, adversarial refusing tenant, chaos with slow checkpoints.
ops-bot: canary deploy: admission-guard-v1 -> success on pool-canary-2 :white_check_mark:
Anita V: I'll write a short RFC with sequence diagram. Jin + Theo, please add API sketches to the PR.
